inherited.value: The unit manages a Ground object's color-overlay lifecycle through three operations: `grMaterial_801C9604` installs a command stream, resets timers, loop and interpolation state, clears the completion flag, and performs an initial update; `grMaterial_801C9698` advances the stream and sets `Ground.x10_flags.b4` when playback completes; and `grMaterial_801C95C4` resets the embedded `ColorOverlay` and marks it complete. During playback, the shared interpreter waits on command timers, executes all due commands, advances enabled RGBA interpolation tracks, and can complete either from a command or an expiring finite lifetime.
inherited.rationale: The refreshed grMaterial routines retain the reset, start, update, and completion-flag transitions. The invoked shared interpreter still gates commands by a timer, dispatches due commands, advances both color tracks, and reports completion from commands or lifetime expiry.
